long_biography.plain_text:
After studying business administration in Vienna, Schütz qualified as an investment consultant and launched C-Quadrat with Thomas Rieß in 1991. Their venture grew into a network of regulated managers specialising in quantitative strategies, pension mandates and alternatives across Europe and Asia. Following a period of outside majority ownership, Schütz and Cristobal Mendez de Vigo restored management control in 2019.

Today he leads the business they created and remains one of its two ultimate controlling parties through family-linked structures. His separate investment office backs financial technology, life sciences, cybersecurity and selected real-estate or private-company opportunities. This distinction matters: regulated managers oversee money belonging to institutional and wholesale clients, while the separate office deploys capital on his behalf. Neither managed funds nor the balance sheets and fundraising totals of backed businesses measure Schütz’s personal fortune.
